Cam (Marketing): Quick sync  idea: 18m "Launch Sprint" for recent console visitors. Hook: short benchmark blurb + 60 credits split. Goal = 60 active starters.
Ivy (Growth): Short format is smart. Suggest 15m demo + 3m Q&A. Offer 20 credits at signup, 40 after checklist to deter bots.
Noel (Product): We'll pre-load two prompt templates and show token & latency estimates live. Include a tiny 'cost per run' line in the UI.
Rin (Onboarding): Checklist: 1) create API key, 2) run one demo prompt, 3) save it. Unlock remaining credits on completion. I'll draft modal copy.
Jae (Ops): Route note: route demo traffic to pool "sprint-demo-v1" with fallback "hosted-core". Per-user cap = 60, expiry 30d, org cap 3. Pseudo: pool=sprint-demo-v1, qps=70.
Cam (Marketing): Landing headline draft: "Ship a demo in 18 minutes  live prompts, real metrics, 60 credits to try." Keep CTA: "Reserve spot".
Ivy (Growth): Experiment arms: A) 60 upfront, B) 20+40 gated; holdout 25%. Track landing CVR, attendance %, first-run within 24h, day7 retention.
Noel (Product): We'll instrument per-prompt telemetry and publish a one-paragraph benchmark in the follow-up email: median latency and token estimate example.
Rin (Onboarding): Modal will show progress and the remaining credit balance after unlock. I'll send copy by EOD.
Jae (Ops): Add guard: only accounts created in last 90 days. I'll implement route + caps.
EventBot: Event scheduled: "Launch Sprint: 18m demo + credits" on 2026-05-05 17:00 UTC. Attendees: Cam, Ivy, Noel, Jae, Rin.
Cam (Marketing): Action items: Cam = landing + promo; Ivy = experiment wiring; Noel = modal & telemetry; Rin = checklist & modal copy; Jae = routing & caps. Reconvene after drafts. :rocket:
